teacher_onboarding_handoff_private:
  base_path: /internal
  auth: exact_dedicated_teacher_onboarding_handoff_token
  auth_env: TEACHER_ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_INTERNAL_TOKEN
  feature_flag: PLANNER_ONBOARDING_HANDOFF_ENABLED defaults false and requires PLANNER_GRAPH_READINESS_ENABLED
  routes:
    - {method: POST, path: '/students/{studentID}/onboarding-plan-handoffs', input: teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff-request.v1, output: teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff.v1, idempotency_key: required_single_byte_canonical_uuid, body_max_bytes: 16384, cache_control: no-store, first_status: 201, exact_replay_status: 200}
  request:
    required: [schema, expected_state_ref, dialog_id, teacher_job_id]
    schema: teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff-request.v1
    expected_state_ref: {kind: [accepted_draft, finalized_profile], version: positive_integer}
    audit_ids: canonical_uuid_only
    idempotency_header: exactly_one_byte_canonical_uuid_no_whitespace
    additional_properties: forbidden
  response:
    schema: teacher-onboarding-plan-handoff.v1
    required: [schema, handoff_id, status, state_ref, goal, execution_status, content_status, readiness_observed_at, replayed]
    status: ACCEPTED
    execution_status: NOT_STARTED
    content_status: NOT_CREATED
    readiness_observed_at: canonical_utc_timestamp
  errors:
    invalid_student_id: 400
    invalid_idempotency_key: 422
    invalid_request: 422
    capability_disabled: 503
    idempotency_conflict: 409
    state_changed: 409
    active_path_exists: 409
    not_ready: 422
    student_state_unavailable: 502
    published_graph_unavailable: 503
    published_graph_invalid: 500
    internal_error: 500
  auth_failure:
    status: 403
    media_type: text/plain
    body: forbidden

project_authoring:
  browser_forbidden_fields: [student_id, learning_path_id, goal, course, targets, profile, mastery, runtime, sandbox, practice_start]
  derived_input: exact Student owner path plus immutable onboarding version/profile digest over derived locale and canonical desired stacks capped at 64 bytes each
  response_locale: required exact en|ru from immutable validated authoring input; never recomputed from profile or accepted from the caller
  versioning: project-authoring-flow.v1 remains pre-release v1 only through coordinated lockstep initial deployment; no project-authoring traffic until Planner, strict Teacher, and Next consumer all require locale, with no compatibility fallback or rolling mixed-version deployment
  recovery: lost create replays the exact POST; checkpointed 404 recovery must return the identical TZ job UUID
  boundary: verified READY stages privately as STAGED; publication requires future Practice-owned acceptance integration
exact_path_delivery:
  before_put: persist one immutable compare-and-set checkpoint containing kind, exact path and request/idempotency identities, expected path version, normalized body, private planned outcome, and semantic SHA-256
  ambiguous_transport_retry: replay the checkpointed body with the same planning_request_id and Idempotency-Key; do not reread Student state or recalculate expected_version
  public_outcome: result_code, course_id, and reused remain unset until the Student command succeeds
  delivered_409: terminal FAILED with failure_code LEARNING_PATH_COMMAND_CONFLICT; never retry the doomed checkpoint
  malformed_receipt: terminal FAILED with failure_code LEARNING_PATH_COMMAND_INVALID_RESPONSE
